The approach

Different places. A whole-body way of looking.

Amari does not diagnose these conditions or replace medical care. In the Assessment, Garrett looks at how your whole body is moving and tests whether guided movement can change what you are experiencing.

How the method addresses it

Whatever brought you in, the process is the same.

01

Assessment

Garrett looks at how your body moves and what is getting in the way. He works with the whole body, beyond the part that hurts.

02

Hands-on guidance

Using movement, breath, simple props, and physical support when appropriate, Garrett guides a precise setup while you stay active in the work.

03

What changes

The work can create a substantial, immediate felt change: less pain, more available movement, or a body that no longer has to hold itself in the same way.

04

What comes next

You decide whether to continue. A longer practice gives you time with a skilled teacher as your body changes, plus visual cues to support your work between sessions.
